thread:
maya: Observed repeated latency spikes on pod inference-42 after the KV cache paging threshold hit at ~60s long contexts. Spike at 16:44 UTC after deploy. Memory grows while reuse rate drops. Logs pasted below.
liam: Oof. Any correlate in evicter metrics? eviction_rate / reuse_rate?
maya: eviction_rate jumped x3, reuse_rate fell ~40%. That aligns with longer contexts + FIFO warmset thrash. stack trace/sampled profiler: 
```
cpu: 12.4% evicter_loop
kv::fetch: hotset_miss
kv::reinsert: scan_lock_wait
```
sam: Can you paste the exact deploy id? ops-bot should have it.
ops-bot: deploy maya/runtime-optim/sha:abc123 applied to inference-42 at 2024-11-01T16:40:12Z
maya: repro steps:
1) run long-context workload: `make perf-loaded TEST_CTX=120s -j8`
2) send 600req/s with sequence lengths ~8k tokens
We saw KV paging happen and memory climb + 200-400ms tail latency.
liam: Quick hypothesis: kernel selection + batching heuristics caused a pattern of many small evictions (FIFO path) that broke KV locality; LRU would have promoted reuse. Need to check whether the fallback eviction path is taking the fastpath under backpressure.
jen: Is this deterministic? Any flamegraphs or allocation traces we can attach? Also, are we seeing fragmentation (lots of small slab allocations)?
maya: Flamegraph link: https://perf.internal/r/fg/1735556666 (sampling). Shows evicter lock contention at 50-70% of the tail. Alloc trace: many 4KB pages being reinserted.
liam: If the evicter is holding the eviction mutex while rebatching writes, that could serialise streaming kernels and inflate latency. Could be aggravated by `batching.min_batch_ms` lowered in the deploy.
sam: I checked the deploy diff — we lowered `batching.min_batch_ms` from 4 -> 2ms to reduce median latency. That might increase chattiness and cause the evicter to see more churn.
maya: Proposed mitigations:
- quick: roll back batching.min_batch_ms to 4ms on that cluster
- mid: add a per-hotset backoff when eviction rate exceeds X
- long: make eviction atomic and avoid holding global evicter mutex during reinserts
liam: I can put up a canary rollback within 10m. Also will instrument evicter histograms more granularly.
jen: For correctness, we should verify that reinserts maintain sequence numbers; I want a small unit test for the reinsertion ordering under concurrency.
maya: created issue #INF-2897 with logs and reproducer. Adding folks.
sam: assigning to @liam + @maya. Also filing a perf regression alert if tail > 150ms for 5m.
liam: rolling back now, watching metrics. ping back in ~15m.
ops-bot: rollback maya/runtime-optim/sha:abc123 -> maya/runtime-optim/sha:ab999 at 2024-11-01T16:50:30Z
liam: preliminary: tail latency dropping to baseline after rollback. eviction_rate trending down. will follow up with a deeper postmortem and a proposed patch for atomic evicter reinserts.
maya: Thanks. Leaving the thread open for the postmortem + test plan.
